source: TOOLS_SPEC from the recorded revision; common file tools include MEMORY_BOUNDARY_NOTE appended by MemoryManager.get_common_tool_bindings().

rpent/tools/common.py.name: read_text_file
rpent/tools/common.py.description: Read a UTF-8 text file. Use for past recipe JSONLs, audit JSONs, and memory files. Large files are truncated. Published memory is read-only. During exploration, you may write only to your current memory inbox. Memory for other robots is unavailable.

rpent/tools/common.py.name: write_text_file
rpent/tools/common.py.description: Write a UTF-8 text file (creates parent dirs). Use this to save the working recipe JSONL and the final audit JSON at the end of a successful run. Published memory is read-only. During exploration, you may write only to your current memory inbox. Memory for other robots is unavailable.

rpent/tools/common.py.name: list_dir
rpent/tools/common.py.description: List files in a directory (non-recursive). Default = {{output_dir}}. Use to inspect the working directory or discover existing resource files. Published memory is read-only. During exploration, you may write only to your current memory inbox. Memory for other robots is unavailable.

rpent/tools/common.py.name: finish
rpent/tools/common.py.description: Call when the task is complete or unrecoverable. Halts the agent loop. Save any artifacts (recipe, audit) BEFORE calling finish.

summary.description: Short natural-language summary of the run.

robots/franka/tools.py.name: view_env_state
robots/franka/tools.py.description: Read a Franka state snapshot and its synchronized RGB images.

robots/franka/tools.py.name: view_camera_meta
robots/franka/tools.py.description: Read camera intrinsics, crop, depth, and calibration metadata.

robots/franka/tools.py.name: view_perception_setup
robots/franka/tools.py.description: Read calibrated camera geometry and projection conventions.

robots/franka/tools.py.name: back_project
robots/franka/tools.py.description: Back-project one wrist or external-camera pixel into Franka base coordinates.

robots/franka/tools.py.name: back_project_correspondence
robots/franka/tools.py.description: Fuse matched wrist and external-camera pixels into a Franka base point.

robots/franka/tools.py.name: move_delta
robots/franka/tools.py.description: Move the Franka TCP by a bounded base-frame xyz delta in meters.

robots/franka/tools.py.name: rotate_delta
robots/franka/tools.py.description: Rotate the Franka TCP by a bounded base-frame rpy delta in radians.

robots/franka/tools.py.name: open_gripper
robots/franka/tools.py.description: Open the Franka gripper and wait for the command to settle.

robots/franka/tools.py.name: close_gripper
robots/franka/tools.py.description: Close the Franka gripper and wait for the command to settle.

robots/franka/tools.py.name: vla_grasp
robots/franka/tools.py.description: Run bounded real-world VLA action chunks for a local grasp attempt.

robots/libero/tools.py.name: reset
robots/libero/tools.py.description: EXPLORE MODE ONLY. Abandon the current episode and restore the same initial scene. Archive the failed attempt first and state which strategy lever will change in the next attempt.

reason.description: Why this episode is unrecoverable and what will change.

robots/libero/tools.py.name: view_env_state
robots/libero/tools.py.description: Read one recorded state and its observation artifacts. Step -1 selects the latest entry. Embeds policy, agentview, and wrist images when available. Use the calibration-frame images for pixel back-projection; JSON state alone is not enough. Use agentview for global tabletop layout and object locations; use wrist for close-range details near the gripper, occlusions, and container/cabinet interiors.

robots/libero/tools.py.name: move_to
robots/libero/tools.py.description: Scripted EEF servo to a world-frame XYZ target via the OSC controller. Holds orientation (use rotate_wrist / rotate_pitch / move_pose to reorient). gripper: -1 = open, +1 = close. NEVER command a single move_to with |Δxy| > 0.30 — OSC flips IK and the run corrupts; split long traversal into 2-3 mid waypoints at carry z.

xyz.description: World-frame target [x, y, z] in meters

step_clip.description: Per-step Δxyz cap before action_scale, m (default 0.025)

target_yaw.description: Optional world-frame yaw target in radians

robots/libero/tools.py.name: pi0_pick
robots/libero/tools.py.description: Pi0.5 closed-loop pick. Use it for the grasp; YOU then do every move_to and release. Use modest max_chunks and verify the grasp from EEF lift, gripper closure, and available images.

prompt.description: Pi0 prompt (e.g. 'pick up the akita black bowl').

lift_thresh.description: EEF post-descent ascent threshold for success, m (default 0.05)

gripper_open_thresh.description: Minimum finger separation accepted as a held object (default 0.0)

descent_thresh.description: Required descent before lift detection, m (default 0.10)

robots/libero/tools.py.name: pi0_doubled
robots/libero/tools.py.description: Pi0.5 closed-loop contact skill for non-pick interactions (e.g. stove/knob/button/short push). Returned success/task_success only mirrors official termination; for intermediate contact skills, success=false does not necessarily mean the contact interaction failed. Inspect image/state evidence. Do not use it as a general pick/place shortcut.

prompt.description: Contact-skill prompt, e.g. 'turn on the stove'.

robots/libero/tools.py.name: release
robots/libero/tools.py.description: Open the gripper for up to max_steps env steps while holding EEF in place. Triggers libero termination if the matching On/In predicate is met.

robots/libero/tools.py.name: set_gripper
robots/libero/tools.py.description: Hold the current EEF pose and drive the gripper command for `steps` env steps. Use to firm up a grip mid-carry.

robots/libero/tools.py.name: rotate_wrist
robots/libero/tools.py.description: Rotate the wrist around the world Z-axis. Provide either target_yaw (absolute) or delta_yaw (relative). Holds xyz fixed.

robots/libero/tools.py.name: rotate_pitch
robots/libero/tools.py.description: Tilt the gripper around the world X-axis. Provide either target_pitch (absolute) or delta_pitch (relative). Holds xyz and yaw fixed. Use before threading the gripper into a narrow opening whose front face normal is along world ±y (e.g. microwave cavity).

robots/libero/tools.py.name: move_pose
robots/libero/tools.py.description: Servo position AND orientation (pitch + yaw) SIMULTANEOUSLY. Unlike move_to (holds orientation) + rotate_pitch (holds xyz), this co-varies xyz and wrist tilt every env.step. Use to thread cabinet-front / low-shelf poses where a decoupled position servo drives the wrist into an IK singularity and stalls.

xyz.description: World-frame target [x, y, z] in meters

gripper.description: Gripper command held during the move (default -1)

robots/libero/tools.py.name: view_camera_meta
robots/libero/tools.py.description: Read per-step camera calibration metadata from recorded artifacts.

robots/libero/tools.py.name: segment
robots/libero/tools.py.description: SAM3 visual segmentation over an existing run artifact. It never renders a new camera view. Provide exactly one text prompt or single positive point. A successful top-ranked mask is projected through the matching world map to produce world_xyz.

point.description: Optional single positive point as [row, col]. Mutually exclusive with prompt.

robots/libero/tools.py.name: back_project
robots/libero/tools.py.description:
Back-project a pixel (row, col) to a world XYZ point using the selected camera's precomputed world map. Row 0 = top of image, col 0 = left. Returns world_xyz in meters.

USE THIS to find where an object is in the world — look at the embedded high-resolution image returned by view_env_state to pick a pixel on the target object, then call back_project. The default resolution is high (1024x1024). Pass resolution='low' only for pixels from the embedded/standard 256 image. The pixel coordinates must come from the same camera and resolution requested here. Use camera='agentview' for global tabletop layout and object locations; use camera='wrist' for close-range details near the gripper, occlusions, and container/cabinet interiors. Sample several pixels on the object and median their xy for robustness.

REGION MODE: pass row_range=[r0,r1] and col_range=[c0,c1] instead of row/col to get the midpoint of world xy over that pixel window, with an optional world-z band (z_min, z_max). Use it for the center of a container cavity or flat region, where a single-pixel or mask-median estimate is biased toward an edge/rim.

row.description: Pixel row (0=top) in the selected resolution image.

col.description: Pixel column (0=left) in the selected resolution image.

resolution.description: Coordinate system for row/col (default high). Use low only when row/col came from the embedded/standard 256 image.

row_range.description: Region mode: [r0, r1] pixel row window. Requires col_range.

col_range.description: Region mode: [c0, c1] pixel col window. Requires row_range.

z_min.description: Region mode: keep only pixels with world z >= z_min.

z_max.description: Region mode: keep only pixels with world z <= z_max.

robots/robocasa/tools.py.name: move_to
robots/robocasa/tools.py.description: Scripted EEF servo to a world-frame XYZ target via the OSC controller. Holds pitch/yaw orientation (use rotate_pitch to reorient). gripper='hold' (DEFAULT) maintains current finger width — carry-safe without crushing small objects. Pass +1 to close, -1 to open. NEVER command a single move_to with |dxyz| > 0.30 — OSC flips IK; split long traversal into 2-3 mid waypoints at carry z.

xyz.description: World-frame target [x, y, z] in meters

gripper.description: Gripper: +1 close, -1 open, or 'hold' to maintain current finger width (default 'hold')

robots/robocasa/tools.py.name: move_delta
robots/robocasa/tools.py.description: Relative EEF displacement from the current position. Computes target = current_eef + dxyz and delegates to move_to. Use for small adjustments (micro-align for grasp, approach). gripper='hold' (DEFAULT) maintains current finger width.

dxyz.description: Relative displacement [dx, dy, dz] in meters

robots/robocasa/tools.py.name: rotate_pitch
robots/robocasa/tools.py.description: Tilt the wrist forward (axis-angle about the control X-axis). This pitches the gripper down/up. Holds xyz fixed. Use before threading the gripper into a narrow opening whose front face normal is along world +/-y.

n.description: Number of env steps for the rotation (default 12)

robots/robocasa/tools.py.name: set_gripper
robots/robocasa/tools.py.description: Hold the current EEF pose and drive the gripper command for `steps` env steps. Use to firm up a grip mid-carry or to actively open/close the gripper.

steps.description: Number of env steps to hold (default 10)

robots/robocasa/tools.py.name: release
robots/robocasa/tools.py.description: Open the gripper for `steps` env steps while holding EEF in place. Delegates to set_gripper(-1.0, steps=steps). Use to drop a grasped object.

robots/robocasa/tools.py.name: scripted_grasp
robots/robocasa/tools.py.description: Coarse scripted grasp sequence: open -> hover above target -> descend -> close -> lift. A fallback when the VLA closed-loop grasp is unavailable. For hard objects prefer rldx_arm. approach_z and grasp_z_offset are RELATIVE offsets from the target xyz.

xyz.description: World-frame grasp target [x, y, z] in meters

approach_z.description: Z offset above target before descent, m (default 0.10)

grasp_z_offset.description: Z offset at grasp point (default 0.0; negative = below target)

step_clip.description: Per-step dxyz cap during descent, m (default 0.02)

robots/robocasa/tools.py.name: rldx_skill
robots/robocasa/tools.py.description: RLDX VLA closed-loop skill — FULL base motion allowed. The VLA drives both arm and mobile base. Use for full-body tasks where the base must reposition (e.g. navigating to a counter while reaching). Pass the complete live task_language verbatim; the runtime always uses that environment language for RLDX. Do NOT interrupt consecutive VLA calls with manual primitives — that breaks VLA frame history continuity (sets vla_desync=True).

base_clip.description: Base motion magnitude cap (default null = no clamp)

force_reset.description: Force VLA frame history reset (default False)

settle_patience.description: Settle step budget before declaring done (default 999; do NOT set small)

robots/robocasa/tools.py.name: rldx_arm
robots/robocasa/tools.py.description: RLDX VLA closed-loop skill — base CLAMPED to small motions (base_clip=0.1 default). The VLA drives the arm for precise micro-alignment (e.g. fine-tuning a grasp approach) but cannot drive the base away. Pass the complete live task_language verbatim; the runtime always uses that environment language for RLDX. Do NOT interrupt consecutive VLA calls with manual primitives.

force_reset.description: Force VLA frame history reset (default False)

settle_patience.description: Settle step budget before declaring done (default 999; do NOT set small)

robots/robocasa/tools.py.name: navigate_to
robots/robocasa/tools.py.description: Drive the mobile base toward a WORLD (x, y) target. Online-calibrates the base forward-heading, then turns to face + drives forward closed-loop. Holds the arm in place. gripper='hold' (DEFAULT) maintains current finger width while driving (carry-safe). Use tol = expected approach distance + object radius.

xy.description: World-frame target [x, y] in meters (z ignored if provided)

gripper.description: Gripper while driving: +1 close, -1 open, or 'hold' (default 'hold')

robots/robocasa/tools.py.name: move_base
robots/robocasa/tools.py.description: Raw base velocity commands in the robot's LOCAL frame. +forward = drive forward, +lateral = strafe right, +turn = rotate CCW (yaw). All values clamped [-1, 1]. Use move_base for fine base adjustments near a target; use navigate_to for long-range navigation. gripper='hold' (DEFAULT) maintains finger width while driving.

gripper.description: Gripper while driving: +1 close, -1 open, or 'hold' (default 'hold')

robots/robocasa/tools.py.name: reset
robots/robocasa/tools.py.description: Restart the episode (new layout / object placement sampled). Arm and base calibration are invalidated on reset. DISABLED in no-reset / matched evaluation — the policy must solve the scene in one shot. Only available in EXPLORE mode when RLDX_ALLOW_RESET is enabled.

robots/robocasa/tools.py.name: view_env_state
robots/robocasa/tools.py.description: Read step NN from states.json + the matching state images in the output dir. If step is null, returns the latest entry. Each entry contains the env state, robocasa_terminated flag, task_progress, vla_desync status, and log. Embeds available PNGs as multimodal image content blocks. Use calibration-frame agentview images for pixel back-projection; use navview for base navigation and floor walkability; use wrist for close-range details near the gripper.

robots/robocasa/tools.py.name: back_project_batch
robots/robocasa/tools.py.description:
Back-project MULTIPLE pixels to world XYZ points in a single call. Loads the world map once and queries all pixels — replaces N separate back_project calls. Returns each pixel's world_xyz plus a summary with median_xyz across valid pixels.

USE THIS for robust object localization: sample 3-8 pixels on the target object and read summary.median_xyz. Maximum 50 pixels per call.

step.description: Depth / world-map step to use (default latest).

resolution.description: Coordinate system for pixels (default low). Use 'low' for the standard 256x256 world map.

robots/robocasa/tools.py.name: query_world_map
robots/robocasa/tools.py.description:
Query the world map by Z-range / XY region to find objects at specific heights. Loads the world map once, filters pixels by z_min <= z <= z_max, optionally restricts to x_range / y_range, then clusters contiguous pixels into objects.

TYPICAL USES:
- z_min=0.85, z_max=0.95 -> countertop-height objects
- z_min=0.0, z_max=0.12, camera='navview' -> walkable floor
- z_min=0.85, z_max=0.95, x_range=[0,2], y_range=[-3,-1] -> counter objects in a specific quadrant

z_min.description: Minimum Z in meters (default 0.85 for counter height).

z_max.description: Maximum Z in meters (default 0.95 for counter height).

x_range.description: Optional X range [min, max] in meters; null = no filter.

y_range.description: Optional Y range [min, max] in meters; null = no filter.

camera.description: Camera world map to query (default agentview).

min_cluster_size.description: Minimum pixels per cluster to report (default 10).

robots/robocasa/tools.py.name: finish
robots/robocasa/tools.py.description: Declare the task finished. Call when robocasa_terminated becomes True (success detected), or when genuinely stuck after honest exploration. Provide a 1-3 sentence summary of what worked and what failed.

summary.description: 1-3 sentence summary of what worked / what failed.

robots/robotwin/tools.py.name: view_env_state
robots/robotwin/tools.py.description: Read one EnvState step and its synchronized RoboTwin observation artifacts. Step -1 selects the latest entry. Embeds the head, left wrist, and right wrist RGB images when available.

robots/robotwin/tools.py.name: render
robots/robotwin/tools.py.description: Capture a fresh synchronized RoboTwin agent observation.

robots/robotwin/tools.py.name: sample_world_xyz
robots/robotwin/tools.py.description: Read persisted same-frame world xyz around [row,col] pixels. The view is also the pixel coordinate space: use the exact view whose RGB supplied the pixels. The current state's view_specs gives each view's [height,width]. This is read-only and does not render or move the robot.

view.description: Artifact view and pixel coordinate space. It must match the RGB image used to choose pixels.

robots/robotwin/tools.py.name: query_world_map
robots/robotwin/tools.py.description: Read deterministic world-xyz samples from a half-open [row_start,col_start,row_end,col_end] region. The view is also the bbox coordinate space and must match the source RGB artifact; view_specs gives [height,width]. This is read-only.

view.description: Artifact view and bbox coordinate space. It must match the RGB image used to choose the bbox.

robots/robotwin/tools.py.name: lingbot_act
robots/robotwin/tools.py.description: Run LingBot-VLA eef16 actions using the native task instruction. The optional prompt is recorded but never sent to the policy.

robots/robotwin/tools.py.name: move_to
robots/robotwin/tools.py.description: Plan and move one arm to a world-frame xyz and wxyz orientation. The native planner returns qpos waypoints executed with fresh state.

robots/robotwin/tools.py.name: rotate_wrist
robots/robotwin/tools.py.description: Rotate one EEF about world Z by a relative angle in degrees.

robots/robotwin/tools.py.name: set_gripper
robots/robotwin/tools.py.description: Linearly move one normalized gripper to val over 10 actions.

robots/robotwin/tools.py.name: release
robots/robotwin/tools.py.description: Open one gripper to 1.0 over 10 native actions.

robots/robotwin/tools.py.name: reset
robots/robotwin/tools.py.description: Restart the episode for a fresh exploration attempt. Available only in explore mode. Re-run perception after every reset.

robots/robotwin/tools.py.name: finish
robots/robotwin/tools.py.description: Stop the run. A fresh native status query is authoritative; requesting success cannot override TASK_ENV.eval_success.

robots/robodojo/tools.py.name: view_env_state
robots/robodojo/tools.py.description: Read one recorded RoboDojo state: robot joint/ee state, camera shapes and calibration, the task instruction, and the three camera RGB images (cam_head, cam_left_wrist, cam_right_wrist). Step -1 selects the latest record.

robots/robodojo/tools.py.name: back_project
robots/robodojo/tools.py.description: Project one pixel from a camera image to a world xyz coordinate using depth + intrinsics/extrinsics. Use to localize objects.

robots/robodojo/tools.py.name: segment
robots/robodojo/tools.py.description: Segment an object in a camera image by text prompt (SAM 3.0). Returns mask bounding box and score.

robots/robodojo/tools.py.name: move_to
robots/robodojo/tools.py.description: Move an arm end-effector to a world xyz target (scripted motion, CuRobo IK). gripper: 1=close, -1=open, 0=keep.

xyz.description: World xyz target for the end-effector

robots/robodojo/tools.py.name: set_gripper
robots/robodojo/tools.py.description: Open or close an arm gripper. 1=close, -1=open.

robots/robodojo/tools.py.name: pi0_pick
robots/robodojo/tools.py.description: Closed-loop Pi_05 pick: feed the observation to the Pi_05 policy, apply its action chunk, and detect grasp success by eef lift + gripper closure.

prompt.description: Optional specific target instruction; omit to use resolved official task language

robots/robodojo/tools.py.name: stabilize
robots/robodojo/tools.py.description: Emergency stabilization: move an arm's open gripper to a world xyz at table height to block/stop a bottle observed rolling in the camera images.

robots/robodojo/tools.py.name: place_in_bin
robots/robodojo/tools.py.description: Place a held object into the dustbin: carry above the bin mouth center, descend BELOW the rim, release, then retract. Use the bin mouth center you localized (not the near edge).

bin_center_xyz.description: Bin mouth center at approach height

approach_z.description: Safe carry height above the bin (default 0.95)

drop_z.description: EE z to descend to before release, BELOW the rim (default 0.78)

robots/yam/tools.py.name: status
robots/yam/tools.py.description: Read fresh episode rules: ready, awaiting ready, terminal, stop or budget. Does not establish visual clearance or drive hardware.

robots/yam/tools.py.name: view_env_state
robots/yam/tools.py.description: Read one synchronized YAM state and image artifacts.

robots/yam/tools.py.name: render
robots/yam/tools.py.description: Capture a fresh synchronized YAM observation.

robots/yam/tools.py.name: reset
robots/yam/tools.py.description: Operator-approved reset for exploration or a fresh task attempt.

robots/yam/tools.py.name: sample_world_xyz
robots/yam/tools.py.description: Read persisted same-frame YAM world xyz around [row,col] pixels.

robots/yam/tools.py.name: query_world_map
robots/yam/tools.py.description: Read deterministic world-xyz samples from a half-open bbox.

robots/yam/tools.py.name: pi05_act
robots/yam/tools.py.description: Run the YAM Pi0.5 qpos14 policy for one or more short chunks.

robots/yam/tools.py.name: move_to
robots/yam/tools.py.description: Plan and move one YAM arm to a left-base xyz and wxyz orientation.

xyz_bounds.description: Optional task-valid [lower_xyz, upper_xyz] containing xyz. Try at most three plans within it; execute only one. Reobserve after recoverable motion failure before choosing another point. Does not relax arrival tolerance or collision checks.

robots/yam/tools.py.name: rotate_wrist
robots/yam/tools.py.description: Rotate one wrist about world Z by a relative angle in degrees.

robots/yam/tools.py.name: set_gripper
robots/yam/tools.py.description: Linearly move one normalized YAM gripper, where 0=closed and 1=open.

robots/yam/tools.py.name: finish
robots/yam/tools.py.description: Stop the run. Fresh env eval_success is authoritative.

robots/dual_franka/tools.py.name: describe_dual_franka_setup
robots/dual_franka/tools.py.description: Read the dual-Franka runtime conventions, camera aliases, VLA policy conditioning text, semantic stop rules, and available primitive names before acting. This is read-only.

robots/dual_franka/tools.py.name: view_env_state
robots/dual_franka/tools.py.description: Read a dual-Franka state snapshot. Configured inline camera views are returned directly; other available views are returned as artifact paths; use read_image to inspect these artifacts.

robots/dual_franka/tools.py.name: view_camera_meta
robots/dual_franka/tools.py.description: Read camera intrinsics, serials, and projection metadata for the dual-Franka rig.

robots/dual_franka/tools.py.name: back_project
robots/dual_franka/tools.py.description: Back-project one pixel from a registered RGBD camera view into shared right-base coordinates. Use a camera listed by view_env_state/view_camera_meta; default is the configured primary metric localization camera.

camera.description: Registered projection view name, e.g. d455 or base. Valid names come from perception.projection_views and the current state's saved artifacts.

robots/dual_franka/tools.py.name: segment
robots/dual_franka/tools.py.description: Use SAM3 on a registered RGB image with either a text prompt or one positive [row, col] point, return a mask overlay for verification, and estimate the mask median point in shared right-base coordinates.

camera.description: Registered projection view name, e.g. d455 or base. Valid names come from perception.projection_views and the current state's saved artifacts.

prompt.description: Text prompt for SAM3. Prefer short object/relation phrases; for the clean-desk box use 'white interior of the black cardboard box' or 'cardboard box'. Avoid over-specific surface words such as 'floor' when grounding is weak. Provide exactly one of prompt or point.

point.description: Positive SAM3 point in camera image coordinates [row, col]. Provide exactly one of prompt or point.

robots/dual_franka/tools.py.name: move_delta
robots/dual_franka/tools.py.description: Move one Franka TCP by a bounded world-frame xyz delta in meters.

arm.description: Which arm to command; the other arm is left uncommanded.

robots/dual_franka/tools.py.name: rotate_delta
robots/dual_franka/tools.py.description: Rotate one Franka TCP by a bounded world-frame rpy delta in radians.

arm.description: Which arm to command; the other arm is left uncommanded.

robots/dual_franka/tools.py.name: open_gripper
robots/dual_franka/tools.py.description: Open one Franka gripper and wait for the command to settle.

arm.description: Which arm to command; the other arm is left uncommanded.

robots/dual_franka/tools.py.name: close_gripper
robots/dual_franka/tools.py.description: Close one Franka gripper and wait for the command to settle.

arm.description: Which arm to command; the other arm is left uncommanded.

robots/dual_franka/tools.py.name: recover_joint_posture
robots/dual_franka/tools.py.description: Reset both arms to their healthy configured joint posture while preserving each gripper's open/closed state. Closed grippers are re-commanded before/after the joint reset so held objects stay clamped, then both TCPs return near their prior poses.

robots/dual_franka/tools.py.name: request_scene_reset
robots/dual_franka/tools.py.description: Exploration-only real-robot reset gate. Ask the human operator to remove/secure held objects and restore the tabletop scene for another attempt, wait for terminal confirmation, then reset the robot posture. This does not automatically restore physical objects like a simulator.

reason.description: Why the scene needs to be restored.

expected_scene_state.description: Short instruction for the operator describing the desired restored layout.

robots/dual_franka/tools.py.name: request_operator_verdict
robots/dual_franka/tools.py.description: Exploration-only human feedback gate. Ask the operator to mark the current physical task state as success, failure, or continue before the planner finishes or starts another attempt.

question.default: Does the current real-robot scene satisfy the task?

robots/dual_franka/tools.py.name: vla_right_grasp
robots/dual_franka/tools.py.description: Run the learned right-grasp VLA segment. The active task prompt decides which object is currently allowed; this tool only defines the capability boundary: right gripper closes and the right TCP lifts.
